info.title: Gemba HTTP API
info.description:
Wire schema for the gemba server's `/api/*` surface (gm-e4.2). The SPA at `web/` consumes a typed client generated from this document; the source of truth lives in `docs/api/openapi.json` and is served at runtime under `/api/openapi.json`.

This MVP covers the read endpoints the SPA depends on day-to-day: health, version, config, repositories, work items, sprints, agents, sessions, escalations, capabilities, and the new-project conversational flow. The remaining `/api/*` surface (consults, walks, planner, perspectives) is acknowledged in `paths` with summary-only stubs and will gain full request/response schemas in follow-up beads.

servers.description: Same-origin (the gemba server is the SPA host).

tags.description: Govern verbs — spec, decision, and constitution surfaces (gm-o9t8.6/.8/.9/.10/.12). Stubs in M1; real implementation under the ASDD epic gm-v0sp.

tags.description: Convenience verbs — single-shot reads that join across plane boundaries (e.g. workspace status).

post.summary: Deterministic onboarding setup before launching the Onboarder LLM. Prepares or adopts the worktree, initializes Gemba/Beads metadata, seeds runtime guidance files, and verifies source-analysis/MCP commands where possible.

200.description: Setup completed. Warnings are non-fatal and are included in the response ledger.

500.description: Setup failed while mutating disk or shelling out.

post.summary: Open a new-project conversation session. Spawns an Onboarder persona and returns a session id.

201.description: Session created. Returns the session id, empty initial state, and an optional greeting from the Onboarder.

post.summary: Submit an operator message. Returns the updated plan-tree state and the Onboarder skill reply.
Nonce-confirmed atomic commit. Executes the 10-step ratification transaction and creates the project on disk.

409.description: Conflict — either the session state has changed since the modal opened (`error` = `stale_state`) or the target directory already exists (`error` = `dir_exists`).

422.description: Dependency cycle detected in the plan tree (`error` = `cycle_detected`).

500.description: Transaction step failed (git_init_failed, beads_init_failed, milestone_create_failed, epic_create_failed, bead_create_failed, dep_resolve_failed, stat_failed, mkdir_failed, project_md_failed, commit_failed).

post.summary: Lightweight project creation. Scaffolds a project (dir + git init + .gemba/workspace.toml + beads DB + initial commit) without spawning the Onboarder or calling an LLM. Same atomic ratify transaction as the conversational flow, but with an empty Milestones[] tree.

200.description: Project scaffolded successfully. `milestone_count` and `epic_count` are both 0 on this path.

500.description: Transaction step failed (git_init_failed, beads_init_failed, mkdir_failed, project_md_failed, commit_failed).

get.summary: Reports whether the Onboarder persona host can resolve an LLM client. The SPA reads this on board empty-state to decide whether to render the optional 'Plan with the Onboarder' CTA.

200.description: Probe result. Always 200 — `available` is the operative signal; when false, `reason` carries the operator-facing diagnostic.

get.summary: Enumerate projects discovered under the configured `default_dir` and any `extra_roots` (gm-root.17.14). Each entry carries a `kind` classifying its setup state — `complete`, `needs_workspace`, or `needs_repo`.

post.summary: Bind a partially-bootstrapped project to a git repo (gm-root.17.14). `mode="create"` runs `git init` at the beads-DB directory and writes `.gemba/workspace.toml` in place. `mode="navigate"` copies the beads DB into an existing git repo and writes `.gemba/workspace.toml` there. Returns the resolved `ProjectEntry` with `kind="complete"` so the SPA can switch the active workspace immediately.

parameters.name: X-GEMBA-Confirm
parameters.description: Idempotency nonce. Replays of the same nonce return the cached response.

200.description: Bind succeeded. Body is the now-complete `ProjectEntry`.

409.description: Conflict — `mode="navigate"` and the target repo already contains a `.beads/` directory the server refuses to clobber (`error` = `beads_dir_exists`).

500.description: Server-side failure during git_init / beads_copy / workspace_toml write.

get.summary: Get tenant metadata.
get.description: Returns the tenant row identified by `tid`. The handler is owner-only: the requested `tid` must equal the request's bearer-bound tenant id, otherwise the server returns 403 cross_tenant_access. Full admin/list endpoints land with gm-o9t8.3.1 follow-ups; OAuth-bound bearer→tenant resolution lands with gm-o9t8.3.5.

github_login.description: Linked GitHub login; omitted when the tenant has no GitHub identity (e.g. `t-default`).

github_id.description: Linked GitHub numeric id; omitted when the tenant has no GitHub identity.

403.description: Cross-tenant access denied — requested tid does not match the bearer-bound tenant.

404.description: Tenant id is well-formed but absent from the tenants table.

503.description: Tenant store is not attached to the running router (boot order / unconfigured).

get.summary: List specs declared in the workspace.
get.description: Read the workspace's spec catalog. Backs `gemba spec ls` and the SPA's Govern tab. Stub: returns 501 until gm-v0sp lands the real listing.

patch.summary: Mutate spec lifecycle status (freeze / unfreeze / archive).
patch.description: PATCH the spec status — `{"status":"archived"}` freezes the spec; `{"status":"active"}` unfreezes. Single PATCH replaces the spec-status verb pair so REST semantics line up with the canonical /api/v1/* surface. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

post.summary: Reconcile a spec against its current implementation (dry-run or apply).
post.description: Compute the drift between the spec and Beads/source. Default is dry-run (returns the diff). With `?apply=1` the server applies the reconciliation atomically against Beads under the X-GEMBA-Confirm nonce. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

parameters.name: apply
parameters.description: When `1`, apply the reconcile plan; otherwise return a dry-run diff.

schema.description: Optional reconcile parameters — operator-supplied notes, scope filters.

202.description: Apply accepted; reconciliation runs asynchronously. Subscribe to `/specs/{slug}/watch` for progress.

get.summary: Subscribe to spec reconciliation events (SSE).
get.description:
Long-lived `text/event-stream` connection that emits Server-Sent Events as the spec reconciles. Event types (`event:` line) are:

- `bead.status` — a watched Beads issue changed status. Payload: `{ "id": "...", "status": "...", "updated_at": "..." }`.
- `spec.drift` — drift detected between spec and Beads. Payload: `{ "spec": "...", "summary": "...", "changes": [...] }`.
- `reconcile.complete` — reconcile run finished. Payload: `{ "run_id": "...", "applied": true|false, "errors": [...] }`.

Each event is `\n\n`-terminated; clients tolerate keep-alive comments (`: ping`). Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

200.description: SSE stream open. Media type is `text/event-stream`; the schema below describes a single event payload, not the line-framed wire format.

schema.description: Decoded event payload (the `data:` line of a single SSE frame). The frame's `event:` line is one of `bead.status`, `spec.drift`, or `reconcile.complete`; concrete payload fields vary per type — see endpoint description.

post.summary: Snapshot the spec's current rendered state.
post.description: Persist a point-in-time render of the spec + its joined Beads view. Used as the input to `adopt` and as the audit trail for reconciliations. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

post.summary: Adopt a snapshot as the spec's canonical baseline.
post.description: Promotes a previously-taken snapshot to the spec's adopted baseline; subsequent reconciles diff against it. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

get.summary: List decisions recorded in the workspace.
get.description: Returns the decision log (ADR-shaped records). Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

post.description: Create an ADR-shaped record in the decision log. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

get.summary: Cross-reference graph for `constitution lint --strict`.
get.description: Returns the directed graph of decision-to-decision references (and decision-to-spec/work-item refs where declared). Backs `gemba constitution lint --strict`, which walks the graph to detect orphan or cyclic references. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

get.summary: Fetch one decision by id.
get.description: Returns the ADR-shaped record plus its inbound/outbound references. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

patch.summary: Lock or unlock a decision against edits.
patch.description: Toggles the decision's `locked` flag. Locked decisions reject subsequent PATCHes from the standard write path so a recorded constitution stays canonical. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

get.summary: Catalog of declared vs referenced labels (spec lint --strict).
get.description: Returns the union of labels declared on specs/decisions/work-items and those referenced from spec bodies. `gemba spec lint --strict` consumes the diff to detect typos and orphaned label refs. Stub: 501 until gm-v0sp.

get.summary: List the keys of secrets stored for a workspace.
get.description: Returns the lexicographically sorted list of keys stored under the workspace. NO endpoint exposes plaintext values — the only consumer of decrypted values is the in-process secret injector for spawned agent sessions.

post.summary: Store or replace a secret value for a workspace.
post.description: Persists the value under (wsid, key) using envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM, per-workspace DEK wrapped by the server-wide KEK). Idempotency is gated by X-GEMBA-Confirm.

parameters.name: X-GEMBA-Confirm
parameters.description: Idempotency nonce. Replays of the same nonce return the cached response.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Secret key (typically an environment variable name).

delete.description: Removes (wsid, key) from the vault. Idempotent — deleting an absent key still returns 204.

parameters.name: X-GEMBA-Confirm
parameters.description: Idempotency nonce. Replays of the same nonce return the cached response.

get.summary: Unified workspace status — backs `gemba` (no args).
get.description: Single-shot read returning the joined work / spec / decision posture for the workspace. The CLI's no-args invocation prints a one-screen summary built from this response. Each section degrades to zero / null when the corresponding subsystem isn't wired (no clone yet → repo=null; no WorkPlane bound → beads all-zero).

workspace_id.description: The workspace id this status is for; echoes the {wsid} path parameter.

mode.description: Workspace mode (gm-o9t8.8). Only 'ad-hoc' is implemented in v1; the others require the ASDD spec/lockfile machinery (epic gm-v0sp).

repo.description: Git posture for the workspace clone. Null when the workspace hasn't been cloned / initialized yet.

beads.description: Counts across the bead lifecycle buckets that drive the dashboard.

open_total.description: Count of every non-terminal bead (state_category in backlog | unstarted | staged | started).

closed_today.description: Beads that transitioned to a terminal state_category in the last 24h.

agents.description: Agent / run summary derived from OrchestrationPlane.ListSessions.

active.description: Count of non-terminal sessions with a heartbeat or start within the active window (currently 5 minutes).

last_run_id.description: Session id of the most recent run.

last_run_status.description: SessionStatus value of the most recent run.

last_run_summary.description: Best-effort one-line description of the most recent run (today: '<agent_id> on <assignment_id>').

embedded_dolt.description: Embedded-dolt supervisor posture (gm-o9t8.1.9). Null when --embedded-dolt is off (external Dolt via --dolt-url) or the noop adaptor is bound. Populated when the gemba-server runs its own dolt sql-server subprocess.

enabled.description: Always true when the field is present (sentinel for the SPA).

state.description: Coarse-grained lifecycle state. The SPA renders a degraded-state banner whenever this is anything other than 'ready'.

port.description: Loopback TCP port the supervised dolt sql-server is bound to.

data_dir.description: Filesystem path the supervised dolt sql-server uses for its data.

restart_count.description: Cumulative number of subprocess respawns triggered by failing health probes since the supervisor started. The initial spawn does not count.

last_error.description: Most recent probe / supervise error. Absent when the supervisor is healthy.

get.summary: Stream `git diff` from the server-side workspace repo.
get.description: Spawns `git diff` (or `git diff --cached` when `staged=true`) in the workspace repo at `<workspaces_root>/<wsid>/repo/` and streams stdout straight to the response body as `text/x-patch`. Auth-gated; GET only, so no `X-GEMBA-Confirm` nonce. Path filters are validated against an allow-list to reject `..`, absolute paths, and shell metacharacters. Returns 503 when the server has no workspaces root configured, 404 when the workspace repo is missing, and 400 for unsafe path filters.

parameters.name: staged
parameters.description: When true, run `git diff --cached` to show staged changes only.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Optional repeatable path filter (equivalent to `git diff -- <paths>`). Only safe relative paths inside the repo are accepted.

200.description: Streamed `git diff` output. Empty body when there are no changes.

503.description: Workspaces root not configured on this server.

get.summary: Identity probe — returns the subject the bearer/cookie maps to.
get.description: Used by `gemba login` to validate a personal access token and by `gemba whoami` to confirm an existing credential is still accepted. The auth middleware gates this route; an unauthenticated call returns 401 before the handler runs (gm-o9t8.1.1.2).

post.summary: Append a free-form operator note to a WorkItem (stub; gm-o9t8.1.3.2).
post.description: Stub endpoint. Pinned shape so the typed client and CLI can target it day-one; backend storage lands in a follow-up bead.

ConfirmNonce.name: X-GEMBA-Confirm
ConfirmNonce.description: Idempotency nonce required by every state-mutating endpoint. The value MUST be a UUID v4 the caller generated locally. Replays of the same nonce against the same route return the cached prior response within the nonce TTL (per-process; see internal/server/nonce.go). Missing or malformed values yield 400. Documented under gm-o9t8.14 as the canonical write-confirm header.

WorkspaceID.name: wsid
WorkspaceID.description: Workspace identifier. Canonical form is `<tenant-prefix>:<slug>` where tenant-prefix is the first 6 characters of the owning tenant id (e.g. `t-abcd:my-project`). A bare `<slug>` (no colon) is accepted for M1 backwards compatibility and resolves to the well-known DefaultTenant (`t-default`). The server rejects cross-tenant access with 403 when the wsid's tenant-prefix does not match the request's bearer-bound tenant. Pinned in decision gm-o9t8.3.9.

TenantID.name: tid
TenantID.description: Tenant identifier. Format `t-<8 lowercase alphanumeric>` (RFC 4648 base32 alphabet relaxed to include `0-9`), or the well-known constant `t-default` used for single-user installs and the M1 upgrade path. Pinned in decision gm-o9t8.3.9.

SpecSlug.name: slug
SpecSlug.description: Spec slug — the URL-safe identifier the spec was created with (matches `gemba spec ls` output).

NotImplemented.description: Endpoint stub — wire shape is pinned but the server has not yet implemented the operation. Body carries `{ "error": { "code": "not_implemented", "message": "..." } }`.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request — invalid query parameters or body.

AdaptorUnavailable.description: Adaptor is not registered or is degraded; the SPA shows a banner and keeps cached data visible.

Unsupported.description: The bound adaptor does not support this operation.

SecretKeyList.description: Key listing for a workspace's vault. Never includes plaintext values.

keys.description: Lexicographically sorted secret keys for the workspace.

SecretPutRequest.description: Body for POST /api/v1/workspaces/{wsid}/secrets/{key}. The value is stored encrypted at rest under a per-workspace DEK.

value.description: Plaintext secret value. The server never persists this verbatim; it is sealed with AES-256-GCM under the workspace DEK.

Error.description: Shared error envelope (gm-faz). `error` is a stable token the SPA branches on; `message` is human-readable and may be surfaced verbatim.

BeadsSource.description: Workspace identity — 1:1 with a beads database (gm-77u). Detail strips credentials when source is a dolt-url.

WorkItem.description: Subset of the WorkItem fields most commonly read by the SPA. The full shape (relationships, evidence, dod, derived signals, custom fields) is the source of truth in `core/types.go` and `web/src/types/core.gen.ts`; this schema documents the wire-stable subset for a typed client. `additionalProperties: true` keeps clients forward-compatible with fields landing in follow-up beads.

CapabilityManifest.description: Subset of the manifest fields the SPA actively gates UI on. Full manifest (state_map, edge_extensions, query_languages, etc.) is documented in `core/manifest.go`; this schema captures the wire-stable boolean / version surface.

CapabilitiesResponse.description: Registered transport planes plus runtime mode metadata.

ChangeRef.description: Points into the plan tree for the most-recent skill edit. The SPA tone-codes the diff badge by `kind`. Path is slash-joined (e.g. `milestone:1/epic:0/bead:2`); empty means the change spans the whole tree.

kind.description: Labels what changed. Empty string means the skill did not categorise the change.

summary.description: Human-readable one-liner. Empty when the skill did not synthesise one.

DraftBead.description: Leaf of the plan tree. All fields are required; empty strings and zero integers are valid empty states (no missing-key surprises at ratification).

Type.description: One of `task` | `bug` | `feature` | `chore` today. Open string so future bead kinds do not break the SPA.

DependsOnRefs.description: Intra-tree refs (e.g. `milestone:0/epic:1/bead:2`). Ratification resolves these to real bd-… ids in step 8a.

BlocksRefs.description: Intra-tree refs for beads this bead blocks.

DraftEpic.description: Groups beads under a milestone in the plan tree.

DraftMilestone.description: Top-level node of the plan tree. The `type:milestone` label is added by ratification, not by the skill.

NewProjectState.description: Authoritative server-side state for one new-project session. Each turn returns a fresh copy; the client replaces its local copy wholesale rather than merging diffs.

Architecture.description: Free-form architecture notes captured from the operator.

DraftProjectMD.description: Running narrative the skill keeps current each turn. Ratification persists this verbatim as `docs/project.md`.

Turn.description: Monotonic turn counter. Starts at 0; incremented on every successful turn. The ratify endpoint uses this as a stale-modal guard.

OnboardingSetupRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/v1/onboarding/setup`. This deterministic gate runs before any Onboarder LLM session starts.

origin.description: Project source branch selected by the operator.

project_name.description: Gemba display name and local project identity.

worktree_path.description: Absolute native worktree path. Required when orchestration is native.

gastown_location.description: Absolute Gas Town city/town root. Required when orchestration is gastown; used as cwd for gt commands.

gastown_rig.description: Optional Gas Town rig name. Defaults from project_name when omitted. Existing rigs are reused before creation.

gastown_worktree_path.description: Optional absolute path to the selected rig worktree. When omitted, setup uses gt rig list metadata or common rig-root fallbacks.

beads_url.description: Optional mysql:// Dolt URL for the Beads database. Gas Town projects bind Beads through this URL, not through the rig directory.

source_analysis_tool.description: Source-analysis backend. Existing/imported codebases default to gitnexus in the SPA.

OnboardingSetupResponse.description: Returned by `POST /api/v1/onboarding/setup` after deterministic setup completes or completes with warnings.

checks.description: Best-effort setup statuses such as git_sync, workspace, beads, source_analysis, gemba_mcp, and source_analysis_mcp.

session_id.description: Opaque session id used to scope subsequent /turn and /ratify calls. Lives only in server memory.

greeting.description: Optional opening line from the Onboarder. Empty string when the skill did not emit one.

message.description: Operator message. Free text — the skill parses intent.

edits.description: Optional in-place edits the operator made to the plan preview pane since the last turn. Open shape — the skill interprets the path-keyed diff.

reply.description: Skill reply for the conversation pane. Empty when the skill updates the plan silently.

reply_id.description: Server-assigned message id for the reply (stable across re-renders).

RatifyRequest.description: Request body for `POST /api/v1/newproject/:id/ratify`. The server compares the submitted `state.Turn` against the live session and rejects mismatches (stale-modal guard).

RatifyResponse.description: Success envelope returned by `POST /api/v1/newproject/:id/ratify` after the 10-step transaction completes. The SPA owns post-ratify navigation (gm-root.17.7); the server returns the new project's filesystem root, its display name, and the seeded milestone / epic counts so the handoff screen can render 'seeded N milestones and M epics' without re-querying the new workspace's beads database.

project_path.description: Filesystem path of the new project root (default_dir/<project-name>/).

project_name.description: Human-readable project name echoed from the ratified state.

milestone_count.description: Number of milestones created by the transaction.

epic_count.description: Number of epics created by the transaction (sum across all milestones).

RatifyError.description: Structured error returned by `POST /api/v1/newproject/:id/ratify` when any transaction step fails. `error` is a stable machine-readable code; `step` is the 1-based transaction step that failed.

message.description: Human-readable diagnostic surfaced in the toast.

step.description: 1-based transaction step that failed (1..10; step 8a dep-resolution is encoded as 8).

CreateProjectRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/v1/newproject/create` — the lightweight project-creation path. No session, no Onboarder, no LLM. The server runs the same atomic ratify transaction the conversational flow uses, but with an empty Milestones[] tree (gm-root.17.13).

project_name.description: Project name. Used as the directory name under default_dir.

description.description: Optional one-or-two-line description. Mirrored into .gemba/workspace.toml and the synthesised docs/project.md.

OnboarderProbeResponse.description: Body for `GET /api/v1/onboarder/probe`. Always 200; `available` is the operative signal. When `available` is false, `reason` carries the operator-facing diagnostic the SPA can surface verbatim.

available.description: True when the Onboarder persona host can resolve an LLM client (i.e. the conversational flow at /onboard would not 503).

reason.description: Operator-facing diagnostic explaining why the Onboarder is unavailable. Empty / omitted when available is true.

ProjectKind.description: Setup-state classification for a discovered project (gm-root.17.14). `complete` — has a beads DB, a `.gemba/workspace.toml`, and is inside a git repo; the picker switches to it directly. `needs_workspace` — has a beads DB but no `.gemba/workspace.toml`. `needs_repo` — has a `.gemba/workspace.toml` but is not inside a git repo. Open string at the wire so future kinds don't break clients.

ProjectEntry.description: One discovered project. `name` is the directory basename; `path` is the absolute disk path; `active` is true for the currently-selected project (in-process server state; resets on server restart); `kind` classifies the entry's setup state.

ProjectsEnvelope.description: Body of `GET /api/v1/projects`. The deduped union of `default_dir` and every entry in `[projects].extra_roots` from `~/.gemba/config.toml`.

BindProjectRequest.description: Body for `POST /api/v1/projects/bind`. `mode="create"` runs `git init` at `beads_db_path` (which must equal `target_repo_path`) and writes `.gemba/workspace.toml` in place. `mode="navigate"` copies the beads DB at `beads_db_path/.beads/` into `target_repo_path/.beads/` and writes `.gemba/workspace.toml` at `target_repo_path` — `target_repo_path` must already be a git working tree.

beads_db_path.description: Absolute path to the directory holding the beads DB (the parent of the `.beads/` subdir).

target_repo_path.description: Absolute path to the directory to bind to. Equals `beads_db_path` when `mode="create"`.

PersonaScopeView.description: Persona scope (gm-k2jn). `kind` is one of project / repository / any. `repository` is set iff kind=repository.

PersonaPurview.description: gm-9rv §3 — gate authority by phase. Optional.

PersonaSummary.description: Operator-facing persona projection (internal/server/personas.go personaSummary). Heavy fields (system_prompt, model config, budget) are intentionally omitted.

ListPersonasResponse.description: Body of `GET /api/v1/personas`. Sorted by id ascending.

SpecKitFeatureList.description: Spec Kit feature discovery result. `configured=false` means neither specs/ nor .specify/specs/ exists under the active Beads directory.

SpecKitFeature.description: One Spec Kit feature directory and the parsed artifacts Gemba can project into Beads.

SpecKitSyncPlan.description: Read-only staged Beads reconciliation plan for one Spec Kit feature. The hash must be echoed back when applying the plan.

jsonl.description: bd-importable JSONL manifest for create/update portability.

plan_hash.description: Hash from the latest sync plan preview.

allow_deletes.description: Must be true when the staged plan deletes stale source:spec-kit Beads.

subject.description: Identity the credential maps to. v1 returns a static 'operator' for the single-token model; multi-identity arrives with M3 OAuth.

server_version.description: Build version of the gemba server.

WorkItemPatch.description: Partial update for a WorkItem. Mirrors core.WorkItemPatch — every field is optional.
